headline: Pirelli Falls 3% in Milan Following Sinochem Secondary Share Offering
summary: Shares in Italian tiremaker Pirelli fell 3% to €6.55 on the Milan exchange following reports that major Chinese shareholder Sinochem initiated a secondary share placement.
why: Secondary share sales by dominant sovereign or industrial backers increase free-float liquidity but exert immediate downward technical price pressure.
